title: ROPA30 - backup file (encrypted)
description: Password-encrypted backup of a ROPA30 register. The plaintext is the UTF-8 JSON of a plain backup (backup.schema.json). Key derivation: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 on the password normalised to Unicode NFC, with the stated salt and iterations, producing a 256-bit AES key. Encryption: AES-256-GCM (128-bit tag appended to the ciphertext) with the stated IV. Additional authenticated data: the UTF-8 encoding of the header fields joined by '|', in this order: format, version, kdf.name, kdf.hash, kdf.iterations, kdf.salt, cipher.name, cipher.iv (iterations in decimal, salt and IV in their Base64 form as written in the file). Any change to the header therefore makes decryption fail.

iterations.description: Number of iterations (600000 when produced by the current application; values outside the stated range are rejected).

salt.description: Random salt, Base64 (16 bytes when produced by the current application).

ciphertext.description: Ciphertext followed by the GCM authentication tag, Base64.
